Run Your Sales Without SAP Dependency

Managing sales operations through traditional ERP systems like SAP often leads to delays, dependency, and operational complexity. Ezupp ERP is built to simplify this by bringing the entire sales lifecycle into one unified platform.

The Problem

Businesses today rely heavily on SAP for managing customers, products, pricing, and orders. This creates:

  • Dependency on sync cycles
  • Duplicate data across systems
  • Slow order processing
  • Limited flexibility for business teams

The Ezupp Approach

Ezupp ERP removes this dependency by handling everything internally—from customer management to order execution.

Order Lifecycle

The entire workflow is managed in one streamlined flow:

Punch → Quotation → Approval → Finalized → Confirmed → In Progress → Dispatched

Beyond Sales

Ezupp also includes:

  • Mobile apps for sales teams and partners
  • Admin dashboard for full control
  • WhatsApp integration
  • Digital warranty activation
  • Loyalty and rewards system

Warranty & Tracking

Track product movement across Primary → Secondary → Tertiary sales with QR-based warranty activation, ensuring transparency and reducing fraud.

Why Ezupp

  • Faster operations
  • Single source of truth
  • Real-time visibility
  • Flexible workflows

Ezupp ERP enables businesses to run faster, smarter, and with complete control over their sales ecosystem.
